scope: Pure original endpoint discovery/parsing and credential/error helpers; no DSH service or AgentSession.

files.adaptation: Local pure dependencies/types replace the aggregate DSH package; Pi owns installed catalogs and injects fetch lifetime. Supplier attribution is omitted, redirects are refused and provider page coverage is exposed. Original listing path/body/parser behavior is preserved. The same public coded HarnessError base seats the discovery error instead of importing DSH service types.
